blocks.tamil_translation: the people asked one another. “He spoke only about the Ash'ari people. They have understanding of the Din, and the villagers living around them are ignorant of the Din,' the people said among themselves. When this news reached the Ash'ari people, they came into the presence of Rasulullah ﷺ and asked, “Ya Rasulallah! You praised some groups and expressed displeasure with us; what is our fault?” “Either these people teach Ilm to those living near them, advise them, enjoin good deeds upon them and stop them from evil deeds, and likewise learn the Din from those living near them, take advice from them and gain understanding of the Din; otherwise, I will punish all of them severely in this very world,” Rasulullah ﷺ said (for the second time). Hearing this, the Ash'ari people asked, “Ya Rasulallah, must we make others learned?” and Rasulullah ﷺ again said the words he had said before. When they asked the same thing a third time, the Prophet ﷺ again said the same. After that they said, “Ya Rasulallah, give us a respite of one year.” The Prophet ﷺ gave them a respite of one year to create understanding of the Din among those living near them, to teach them and to advise them. After this the Prophet ﷺ recited the Ayah (لُعِنَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ م بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ عَلي لِسَانِ دَاؤُدَ وَعِيسَي بْنِ مَرْيَمَ) “Those of the Bani Isra'il who disbelieved were cursed by the tongue of Hazrat Dawud and Hazrat Isa. The reason for this curse is that they disobeyed the command and transgressed the limits.
